+# Independent exponential-polynomial blocks
+
+## Abstract
+
+Independent exponential-polynomial blocks.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Independent exponential-polynomial blocks).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/ExponentialBlockIndependence.block_evaluation_injective`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/ExponentialBlockIndependence.block_evaluation_injective` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every finite index type and injective family of arbitrary complex exponents, the complex-linear map sending a tuple of polynomials to the sum exp(alpha_i*z)*P_i(z) is injective on the whole complex plane. Polynomial degrees and coefficients are unrestricted.
+
+The actual scalar derivative minus alpha maps an exponential block to the corresponding polynomial derivative. Each block therefore belongs to the generalized eigenspace of the actual entire derivative at alpha. Independence of generalized eigenspaces for distinct eigenvalues proves that no nonzero polynomial block can cancel another exponent block.

An algebraic left inverse of the injective evaluation map gives block projections on all complex-valued functions. Their weighted-kernel identities select one exponent in either variable, including when the candidate separated factors are arbitrary entire functions. These projections are consumed in the distinct-block rank obstruction.

+# Entire weighted Hankel kernels and exponential polynomials
+
+## Abstract
+
+Finite separation of the entire quadratic weighted Hankel kernel is equivalent to an exponential-polynomial presentation.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Finite separation on the whole complex plane).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/ExponentialPolynomial.finite_weighted_separation_iff_exponential_polynomial`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/ExponentialPolynomial.finite_weighted_separation_iff_exponential_polynomial` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The quantifier is every entire complex-valued function on Complex. Finite separation means that some natural k and two families of k entire factors represent (z-w)^2*f(z+w) at every complex pair. An exponential polynomial is a finite sum exp(alpha_i*z)*P_i(z), with arbitrary complex exponents and arbitrary complex polynomial coefficients. Repeated exponents and zero polynomials are allowed in this presentation.
+
+Two applications of the difference of the scalar partial derivatives remove the quadratic weight and produce 8*f(z+w). The complete span of all complex translates of f is then finite dimensional. Its product topology is Hausdorff, and finite dimension makes the subspace closed. Pointwise convergence of actual difference quotients proves that scalar differentiation preserves it. No unbounded differentiation operator on a Fock Hilbert space is introduced.
+
+The resulting actual derivative endomorphism decomposes into generalized eigenspaces over Complex. Multiplication by exp(-alpha*z) turns a generalized derivative eigenvector into an entire function with a vanishing iterated derivative. Polynomial primitives and the zero-derivative constant-function theorem reconstruct a genuine polynomial. Conversely, expanding each polynomial at z+w and splitting each exponential gives finitely many entire separated terms.
+
+The statement is about entire functions and finite pointwise separation. Reconstructing actual Hilbert vectors from a completed kernel, proving factorial summability of every polynomial-exponential block, and identifying the existing physical channel are separate modules. The theorem alone does not classify rank three and proves no entropy inequality or all-input elementary-symmetric lower bound.
+
+## References
+

+- Dependency: [D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankel](WeightedHankel.md)

+# The complete entire rank-three profile classification
+
+## Abstract
+
+The complete entire rank-three profile classification.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (The complete entire rank-three profile classification).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/PolynomialKernelRank.separated_three_iff_profile`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/PolynomialKernelRank.separated_three_iff_profile` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every nonzero entire complex f, the kernel (z-w)^2*f(z+w) has at most three entire separated terms exactly when f(z)=c*exp(alpha*z) or f(z)=c*exp(alpha*z)*(z-beta)^2 for complex c, alpha and beta with c nonzero. Both directions and all complex coefficients are included.
+
+Finite separation first gives a finite exponential-polynomial presentation. Algebraic block projections in both variables isolate a block diagonal four-by-four evaluation minor whenever two distinct nonzero exponent blocks occur: one block supplies a nonzero three-point minor and the other a nonzero entry. Any three-term separation would bound this matrix rank by three, a contradiction.
+
+For a polynomial of degree at least three, Hasse-Taylor coefficient rows give a triangular four-by-four minor using rows 0,1,2,3, except that degree seven uses row four in place of row three. Nonzero top weights prove the obstruction for every degree, without a finite degree cutoff. A genuine linear polynomial has a four-by-four minor with determinant B^4.
+
+For a genuine quadratic A+B*z+C*z^2, the coefficient minor on indices 0,1,2,4 has determinant C^2*(B^2-4*A*C). Thus separation at most three forces the complex discriminant to vanish. Conversely a zero discriminant gives a complex shifted square. Multiplication by an exponential preserves the exact separation bound. The probes extend linearly from polynomials to all functions, so no polynomial-factor hypothesis is imposed on a proposed entire separation.
+

+# The minimum separation rank of a quadratic weighted Hankel kernel
+
+## Abstract
+
+Three nearby evaluation points exclude two-term separation of every nonzero continuous quadratic weighted Hankel kernel.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (A nonzero three-point evaluation minor).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.weighted_hankel_three_point_minor`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.weighted_hankel_three_point_minor` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Every nonzero continuous complex f has three complex points whose weighted Hankel evaluation matrix has nonzero determinant. Continuity near a point where f is nonzero supplies three distinct nearby points with every off-diagonal entry nonzero and diagonal zero. This minor is consumed both in the universal lower bound and in the independent-exponent block obstruction.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (A nonzero continuous kernel needs at least three terms).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.not_separated_two_weighted_hankel`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.not_separated_two_weighted_hankel` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every continuous f from Complex to Complex that is not the zero function, the kernel (z-w)^2*f(z+w) has no representation by at most two entire separated terms. Choose a point a with f(a) nonzero and put x=a/2. Continuity supplies a nonzero small t such that f(2*x+t) and f(2*x-t) remain nonzero. At the three points x, x+t, x-t, the symmetric evaluation matrix has zero diagonal and all three off-diagonal entries nonzero. Its determinant is twice their product. Every sum of two separated terms has zero determinant on any such three-by-three evaluation matrix. No polynomial, finite support, finite separation, growth bound or Fock-vector premise on f is used.
+
+**Theorem 1.3 (Three terms for an exponential).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.separated_three_exponential`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.separated_three_exponential` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For all complex c and alpha, including c=0, the weighted kernel of c*exp(alpha*z) has at most three entire separated terms. Expand the squared difference z^2-2*z*w+w^2 and split the exponential of the sum into a product.
+
+**Theorem 1.4 (Three terms for a shifted square).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.separated_three_exponential_square`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Analytic/Entire/WeightedHankelLowerRank.separated_three_exponential_square` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For all complex c, alpha and beta, the weighted kernel of c*exp(alpha*z)*(z-beta)^2 also has at most three entire separated terms. Set p(z)=z^2-beta*z. Then (z-w)*(z+w-beta)=p(z)-p(w), whose square is a sum of three separated terms. These two explicit constructions supply the sufficiency direction of the physical rank-three statement. Exhaustiveness of those profiles requires the separate polynomial-block classification.

+# Bargmann analysis on the completed Fock space
+
+## Abstract
+
+The completed occupation space has an injective entire Bargmann transform with Gaussian control on every bounded disk.
+
+**Definition 1.1 (The completed transform).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.transform`
+
+*Formalization.* `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.transform` (`✓ std3`).
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+H is lp over the natural numbers with complex coordinates and exponent two. The transform of a at z is the inner product of the exponential vector at conjugate z with a. The inner product is conjugate linear in its first argument. No finite support or energy assumption is imposed.
+
+**Theorem 1.2 (An entire factorial series).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.has_fpower_series`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.has_fpower_series` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every a in H, the full formal multilinear power series at zero has infinite radius and sums to the transform. Its coefficient of degree n is a(n) divided by sqrt(n!). This is a theorem about the actual completed vector.
+
+**Theorem 1.3 (Entire evaluation).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.entire`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.entire` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The transform of every completed vector is complex differentiable at every complex point. An arbitrary entire function is not thereby assigned a vector in H.
+
+**Theorem 1.4 (Absolute radial control).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.tsum_radial_le`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.tsum_radial_le` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every nonnegative real radius R, the sum over all n of norm(a(n))*R^n/sqrt(n!) is at most norm(a)*exp(R^2/2). The proof applies lp Holder to the actual exponential vector, whose squared norm is exp(R^2). The sum includes all coordinates, including at R=0.
+
+**Theorem 1.5 (Recovery of every coordinate).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.injective`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.injective` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+Equality of two transforms as functions on the whole complex plane implies equality of their original H vectors. Uniqueness of the convergent power series recovers each factorial-normalized coordinate.
+
+**Theorem 1.6 (Hilbert limits give local uniform limits).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.uniform_of_tendsto`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.uniform_of_tendsto` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+For every index type, every filter, every net u converging to a in the H norm, and every nonnegative radius R, the transforms of u converge uniformly to the transform of a on the closed disk of radius R. The Gaussian difference bound supplies one estimate for all points of that disk.
+
+**Theorem 1.7 (Totalness in the completion).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.exponential_dense_span`
+
+*Proof.* Machine-checked in Lean as `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/Bargmann.exponential_dense_span` (`✓ std3`). ∎
+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The topological closure of the complex span of all actual exponential vectors is all of H. A vector in its orthogonal complement has zero transform and therefore every coordinate zero. This supplies the density used in the later coefficient-operator reconstruction; no assertion about entropy is made here.

+# Actual Hilbert sections of the completed kernel
+
+## Abstract
+
+Actual Hilbert sections of the completed kernel.
+
+**Theorem 1.1 (Actual Hilbert sections of the completed kernel).**
+
+Lean statement: `D5/S3/Quantum/QuantumChannels/FockAttenuator/BargmannKernel.kernel_eq_transform_discarded_section`

+
+*Source.* Repository-derived.
+
+*Commentary.*
+
+The two-mode carrier is lp(Natural -> H,2), with H=lp(Natural -> Complex,2). Each evaluation section is constructed as an actual H vector by continuous coordinate functionals or an absolutely convergent H-valued contraction. The kernel is the Bargmann transform of that genuine section.
+
+The kernel agrees with the inner product against the actual two-mode exponential vector, with the conjugation convention explicit. Its absolute value is bounded by norm(V)*exp((norm(z)^2+norm(w)^2)/2). Both scalar-variable sections are entire, and the transform is injective on the completed two-mode carrier.

+The discarded and retained contractions obey the corresponding one-variable exponential norm bounds. Tensor inputs give the product of their actual Bargmann transforms. These joins are used to reconstruct finite-rank Hilbert factors from arbitrary entire separated factors; arbitrary entire functions are not assumed to be in the Bargmann image.

+/-- Scalar differentiation on all entire functions. This is an algebraic

+def entireDerivative : Module.End ℂ entireSubmodule where
+  toFun f := ⟨deriv (f : ℂ → ℂ), f.property.deriv⟩
+  map_add' f g := by
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    funext z
+    exact deriv_add (f.property z) (g.property z)
+  map_smul' c f := by
+    apply Subtype.ext
+    funext z
+    exact deriv_const_mul c (f.property z)
+
+def exponentialPolynomialBlock (α : ℂ) (p : Polynomial ℂ) : entireSubmodule :=
+  ⟨fun z => Complex.exp (α * z) * p.eval z,
+    (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp (differentiable_id.const_mul α)).mul p.differentiable⟩
+
+theorem shifted_derivative_block (α : ℂ) (p : Polynomial ℂ) :
+    (entireDerivative - α • 1) (exponentialPolynomialBlock α p) =
+      exponentialPolynomialBlock α p.derivative := by
+  apply Subtype.ext
+  funext z
+  have he := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (α * z)).comp z
+    ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul α)
+  change deriv (fun x => Complex.exp (α * x) * p.eval x) z -
+    α * (Complex.exp (α * z) * p.eval z) =
+      Complex.exp (α * z) * p.derivative.eval z
+  have hd := (he.mul (p.hasDerivAt z)).deriv
+  change deriv (fun x => Complex.exp (α * x) * p.eval x) z = _ at hd
+  rw [hd]
+  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
+  ring

+      exponentialPolynomialBlock α (Polynomial.derivative^[n] p) := by
+  induction n with
+  | zero => simp only [pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply, ih, shifted_derivative_block,

+    rw [Polynomial.derivative_monomial_succ]
+    congr 1

+/-- An entire function killed by an actual iterated scalar derivative is a
+polynomial function. This proof uses primitives and the complex mean-value
+constant-function theorem, rather than a formal ODE premise. -/
+theorem polynomial_of_iterated_deriv_zero (n : ℕ) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
+    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) (hzero : iteratedDeriv n f = 0) :
+    ∃ p : Polynomial ℂ, ∀ z, f z = p.eval z := by
+  induction n generalizing f with
+  | zero =>
+    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
+    intro z
+    simpa only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Polynomial.eval_zero, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hzero z
+  | succ n ih =>
+    have hd : iteratedDeriv n (deriv f) = 0 := by
+      simpa only [iteratedDeriv_succ'] using hzero
+    obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := ih hf.deriv hd
+    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_polynomial_primitive p
+    let g : ℂ → ℂ := fun z => f z - q.eval z
+    have hg : Differentiable ℂ g := hf.sub q.differentiable
+    have hgzero (z : ℂ) : deriv g z = 0 := by
+      change deriv (f - fun x => q.eval x) z = 0
+      rw [deriv_sub (hf z) q.differentiableAt, Polynomial.deriv, hq, hp]
+      exact sub_self _

+    intro z
+    have hc : g z = g 0 := is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hg hgzero z 0
+    simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_C]
+    change f z - q.eval z = g 0 at hc

+    iteratedDeriv n (fun z : ℂ => p.eval z) =
+      fun z => (Polynomial.derivative^[n] p).eval z := by

+  | zero => simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
+    funext z
+    exact Polynomial.deriv _

+      apply Polynomial.funext
+      intro z

+    by_contra hdegree

+    have hc := congrArg (fun q : Polynomial ℂ => q.coeff (p.natDegree - n)) hpoly

+      Polynomial.coeff_zero, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree, nsmul_eq_mul] at hc

+      exact_mod_cast (Nat.descFactorial_pos.mpr hn).ne'

+def exponentialGauge (α : ℂ) (f : ℂ → ℂ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
+  fun z => Complex.exp (-α * z) * f z

+theorem exponential_gauge_entire (α : ℂ) {f : ℂ → ℂ}
+    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) : Differentiable ℂ (exponentialGauge α f) :=
+  (Complex.differentiable_exp.comp (differentiable_id.const_mul (-α))).mul hf

+/-- Multiplication by exp(-α z) conjugates D-α to the scalar derivative. -/

+    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) :
+    deriv (exponentialGauge α f) = exponentialGauge α (deriv f - α • f) := by
+  funext z
+  have he := (Complex.hasDerivAt_exp (-α * z)).comp z
+    ((hasDerivAt_id z).const_mul (-α))
+  have h := (he.mul (hf z).hasDerivAt).deriv
+  change deriv (fun x => Complex.exp (-α * x) * f x) z = _ at h
+  change deriv (fun x => Complex.exp (-α * x) * f x) z = _

+  simp only [exponentialGauge, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
+    Function.comp_apply]

+theorem iterated_deriv_exponential_gauge
+    (W : Submodule ℂ (ℂ → ℂ)) [FiniteDimensional ℂ W]
+    (hentire : W ≤ entireSubmodule)
+    (htranslate : ∀ t, W ≤ W.comap (translateLinear t))
+    (α : ℂ) (n : ℕ) (f : W) :
+    iteratedDeriv n (exponentialGauge α f) =
+      exponentialGauge α (((derivativeEnd W hentire htranslate - α • 1) ^ n) f) := by

+  | zero => simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, pow_zero, Module.End.one_apply]
+  | succ n ih =>
+    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih, pow_succ', Module.End.mul_apply]

+      add_neg_cancel, zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]

+    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) [FiniteDimensional ℂ (translationSpace f)] :

+    ExponentialPolynomial f := by

+  induction s using Finset.induction_on with

+    simp only [Finset.sum_empty]
+    change FiniteSeparated (fun _ _ : ℂ => 0)
+    exact finite_separated_const 0

+    rw [Finset.sum_insert hi]
+    exact (hF i (Finset.mem_insert_self _ _)).add

+    funext z w

+  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
+  simpa using separated_of_fintype (fun _ : Fin 1 => (id : ℂ → ℂ))

+    (fun _ => differentiable_id) (fun _ => differentiable_const _)

+  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
+  simpa using separated_of_fintype (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun _ : ℂ => (1 : ℂ))
+    (fun _ : Fin 1 => (id : ℂ → ℂ))
+    (fun _ => differentiable_const _) (fun _ => differentiable_id)
+
+theorem finite_separated_exponential_hankel (α : ℂ) :
+    FiniteSeparated (fun z w => Complex.exp (α * (z + w))) := by
+  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
+  have he : Differentiable ℂ (fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp (α * z)) :=

+      (fun _ : Fin 1 => fun z : ℂ => Complex.exp (α * z)) (fun _ => he) (fun _ => he)

+theorem finite_separated_weighted_exponential_block (α : ℂ) (p : Polynomial ℂ) :
+    FiniteSeparated (weightedHankel (fun z => Complex.exp (α * z) * p.eval z)) := by
+  have hdiff := (finite_separated_left_coordinate.sub finite_separated_right_coordinate).pow 2

+/-- Every finite polynomial-exponential presentation gives a finite entire

+theorem ExponentialPolynomial.weighted_separation {f : ℂ → ℂ}
+    (hf : ExponentialPolynomial f) : FiniteSeparated (weightedHankel f) := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨n, α, p, hf⟩ := hf

+  exact h

+kernel. Hilbert-space reconstruction and physical beam-splitter rank joins

+theorem finite_weighted_separation_iff_exponential_polynomial {f : ℂ → ℂ}
+    (hf : Differentiable ℂ f) :

+  ⟨exponential_polynomial_of_weighted_separation hf,
+    ExponentialPolynomial.weighted_separation⟩

+#print axioms exponential_polynomial_of_weighted_separation
+#print axioms finite_weighted_separation_iff_exponential_polynomial

+  have h₂ := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ)) (Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose m 2)
+  have h₃ := congrArg (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ)) (Nat.descFactorial_eq_factorial_mul_choose m 3)
+  norm_num [Nat.descFactorial_succ, Nat.descFactorial_one,
+    Nat.cast_sub (show 1 ≤ m by omega), Nat.cast_sub (show 2 ≤ m by omega)] at h₂ h₃
+  have hidentity : (6 : ℂ) * topWeight m 3 =
+      (m : ℂ) * ((m : ℂ)-2) * ((m : ℂ)-7) := by
+    simp only [topWeight, Nat.choose_one_right]
+    linear_combination -h₃ + 6*h₂
+  have h₀ : (m : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show m ≠ 0 by omega)
+  have h2 : (m : ℂ)-2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show m ≠ 2 by omega))
+  have h7 : (m : ℂ)-7 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hm7)
+  intro h
+  rw [h, mul_zero] at hidentity
+  exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h₀ h2) h7 hidentity.symm
+
+private def largeDegreeRows (m : ℕ) : Fin 4 → ℕ :=
+  ![0, 1, 2, if m = 7 then 4 else 3]
+
+private theorem large_degree_rows_strictMono (m : ℕ) : StrictMono (largeDegreeRows m) := by
+  intro i j hij
+  by_cases hm : m = 7 <;> fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
+    norm_num [largeDegreeRows, hm] at *
+
+private theorem large_degree_row_le (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (i : Fin 4) :
+    largeDegreeRows m i ≤ m := by
+  by_cases h : m = 7 <;> fin_cases i <;> simp [largeDegreeRows, h] <;> omega
+
+private theorem large_degree_top_weight_ne_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) (i : Fin 4) :
+    topWeight m (largeDegreeRows m i) ≠ 0 := by
+  fin_cases i
+  · norm_num [largeDegreeRows, topWeight]
+  · simp only [largeDegreeRows, Matrix.cons_val_one, topWeight]
+    exact sub_ne_zero.mpr (by exact_mod_cast (show m ≠ 2 by omega))
+  · exact top_weight_two_ne_zero m hm
+  · by_cases h : m = 7
+    · subst m
+      norm_num [largeDegreeRows, topWeight, Nat.choose_succ_succ]
+    · simpa [largeDegreeRows, h] using
+        top_weight_three_ne_zero m hm h
+
+/-- Every polynomial of degree at least three gives a nonzero triangular
+four-by-four coefficient minor, even when arbitrary entire separated factors
+are allowed. Lower coefficients cannot cancel its top-degree diagonal. -/
+theorem polynomial_degree_ge_three_not_separated_three (p : Polynomial ℂ)
+    (hm : 3 ≤ p.natDegree) :
+    ¬ SeparatedLE 3 (weightedHankel (fun z => p.eval z)) := by
+  classical
+  let m := p.natDegree
+  let I := largeDegreeRows m
+  let J : Fin 4 → ℕ := fun j => m+2-I j
+  let M := kernelProbe (fun i => polynomialCoefficient (I i))
+    (fun j => polynomialCoefficient (J j)) (weightedHankel (fun z => p.eval z))
+  have hJ (j : Fin 4) : 2 ≤ J j := by
+    have h := large_degree_row_le m hm j
+    dsimp [J, I]
+    omega
+  have hentry (i j : Fin 4) :
+      M i j = topWeight (J j+I i-2) (I i) * p.coeff (J j+I i-2) := by
+    change polynomialCoefficient (J j)
+      (fun w => polynomialCoefficient (I i)
+        (fun z => weightedHankel (fun z => p.eval z) z w)) = _
+    simp only [polynomial_row_probe]
+    rw [polynomial_coefficient_eval, polynomial_row_coefficient p (I i) (J j) (hJ j)]
+  have htri : M.IsUpperTriangular := by
+    intro i j hij
+    have hlt : I j < I i := large_degree_rows_strictMono m hij
+    have hle : I j ≤ m := large_degree_row_le m hm j
+    have hdegree : p.natDegree < J j+I i-2 := by
+      change m < J j+I i-2
+      dsimp [J]
+      omega
+    rw [hentry, Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt hdegree, mul_zero]
+  have hdiag (i : Fin 4) : M i i ≠ 0 := by
+    have hi : I i ≤ m := large_degree_row_le m hm i
+    have heq : J i+I i-2 = m := by dsimp [J]; omega
+    rw [hentry, heq, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree]
+    exact mul_ne_zero (large_degree_top_weight_ne_zero m hm i)
+      (Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr (by
+        intro hp
+        rw [hp, Polynomial.natDegree_zero] at hm
+        omega))
+  have hdet : M.det ≠ 0 := htri.det_ne_zero_iff.mpr hdiag
+  intro hsep
+  have hrank := kernel_probe_rank_le hsep
+    (fun i => polynomialCoefficient (I i)) (fun j => polynomialCoefficient (J j))
+  have hfull : M.rank = 4 := by simpa using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet
+  change M.rank ≤ 3 at hrank
+  omega
+
+private def linearMinor (A B : ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ :=
+  !![0, 0, A, B; 0, -2*A, -B, 0; A, -B, 0, 0; B, 0, 0, 0]
+
+/-- A genuine degree-one polynomial has weighted-kernel rank at least four,
+even when the candidate separated factors are arbitrary entire functions. -/
+theorem linear_not_separated_three (A B : ℂ) (hB : B ≠ 0) :
+    ¬ SeparatedLE 3 (weightedHankel (fun z => A+B*z)) := by
+  classical
+  let p : Polynomial ℂ := Polynomial.C A + Polynomial.C B * Polynomial.X
+  let rows : Fin 4 → Polynomial ℂ :=
+    ![Polynomial.C A * Polynomial.X^2 + Polynomial.C B * Polynomial.X^3,
+      Polynomial.C (-2*A) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (-B) * Polynomial.X^2,
+      Polynomial.C A + Polynomial.C (-B) * Polynomial.X, Polynomial.C B]
+  have hd₁ : Polynomial.hasseDeriv 1 p = Polynomial.C B := by
+    dsimp only [p]
+    rw [map_add, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C 1 A (by decide),
+      Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial]
+    norm_num
+  have hd₂ : Polynomial.hasseDeriv 2 p = 0 := by
+    dsimp only [p]
+    rw [map_add, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C 2 A (by decide),
+      Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial]
+    norm_num
+  have hd₃ : Polynomial.hasseDeriv 3 p = 0 := by
+    dsimp only [p]
+    rw [map_add, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C 3 A (by decide),
+      Polynomial.C_mul_X_eq_monomial, Polynomial.hasseDeriv_monomial]
+    norm_num [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by decide : 1 < 3)]
+  have hr (i : Fin 4) : polynomialRow p i = rows i := by
+    fin_cases i <;> norm_num [rows, polynomialRow, hd₁, hd₂, hd₃, p,
+      Polynomial.C_ofNat] <;> ring
+  have hp : (fun z : ℂ => A+B*z) = fun z => p.eval z := by
+    funext z
+    simp [p]
+  have hprobe : kernelProbe (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient i)
+      (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient i)
+      (weightedHankel (fun z => A+B*z)) = linearMinor A B := by
+    rw [hp]
+    ext i j
+    change polynomialCoefficient j
+      (fun w => polynomialCoefficient i (fun z => weightedHankel (fun z => p.eval z) z w)) = _
+    simp only [polynomial_row_probe]
+    rw [polynomial_coefficient_eval, hr]
+    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> dsimp [rows, linearMinor] <;>
+      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
+        Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X, Polynomial.coeff_C] <;> norm_num
+  have hdet : (linearMinor A B).det = B^4 := by
+    norm_num [linearMinor, Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove]
+    ring
+  intro hsep
+  have hrank := kernel_probe_rank_le hsep
+    (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient i) (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient i)
+  rw [hprobe] at hrank
+  have hfull := Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero (show (linearMinor A B).det ≠ 0 by
+    rw [hdet]; exact pow_ne_zero 4 hB)
+  rw [hfull] at hrank
+  norm_num at hrank
+
+private def quadraticRows (A B C : ℂ) : Fin 4 → Polynomial ℂ :=
+  ![Polynomial.C A * Polynomial.X ^ 2 + Polynomial.C B * Polynomial.X ^ 3 +
+      Polynomial.C C * Polynomial.X ^ 4,
+    Polynomial.C (-2 * A) * Polynomial.X + Polynomial.C (-B) * Polynomial.X ^ 2,
+    Polynomial.C A + Polynomial.C (-B) * Polynomial.X +
+      Polynomial.C (-2 * C) * Polynomial.X ^ 2,
+    Polynomial.C C]
+
+private def quadraticMinor (A B C : ℂ) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℂ :=
+  !![0, 0, A, C; 0, -2*A, -B, 0; A, -B, -2*C, 0; C, 0, 0, 0]
+
+private theorem quadratic_coefficient_probe (A B C : ℂ) :
+    kernelProbe (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i))
+      (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i))
+      (weightedHankel (fun z => A + B*z + C*z^2)) = quadraticMinor A B C := by
+  classical
+  let q (w : ℂ) : Polynomial ℂ :=
+    Polynomial.C (w^2 * (A + B*w + C*w^2)) +
+    Polynomial.C (-2*A*w-B*w^2) * Polynomial.X +
+    Polynomial.C (A-B*w-2*C*w^2) * Polynomial.X^2 +
+    Polynomial.C B * Polynomial.X^3 + Polynomial.C C * Polynomial.X^4
+  have hrow (w : ℂ) :
+      (fun z => weightedHankel (fun z => A+B*z+C*z^2) z w) = fun z => (q w).eval z := by
+    ext z
+    simp only [weightedHankel, q, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul,
+      Polynomial.eval_C, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X]
+    ring
+  have hrows (i : Fin 4) :
+      (fun w => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i)
+        (fun z => weightedHankel (fun z => A+B*z+C*z^2) z w)) =
+      fun w => (quadraticRows A B C i).eval w := by
+    ext w
+    rw [hrow, polynomial_coefficient_eval]
+    fin_cases i <;> dsimp [q, quadraticRows] <;>
+      simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
+        Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X, Polynomial.coeff_C,
+        Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C,
+        Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X] <;> norm_num <;> ring
+  ext i j
+  change polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] j)
+    (fun w => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i)
+      (fun z => weightedHankel (fun z => A+B*z+C*z^2) z w)) = _
+  rw [hrows, polynomial_coefficient_eval]
+  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> dsimp [quadraticRows, quadraticMinor] <;>
+    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X_pow,
+      Polynomial.coeff_C_mul_X, Polynomial.coeff_C] <;> norm_num
+
+private theorem quadratic_minor_det (A B C : ℂ) :
+    (quadraticMinor A B C).det = C ^ 2 * (B ^ 2 - 4 * A * C) := by
+  norm_num [quadraticMinor, Matrix.det_succ_row_zero, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.succAbove]
+  ring
+
+/-- The complete complex discriminant obstruction for a genuine degree-two
+polynomial, using all entire separated factors rather than polynomial factors. -/
+theorem quadratic_separated_three_iff (A B C : ℂ) (hC : C ≠ 0) :
+    SeparatedLE 3 (weightedHankel (fun z => A + B*z + C*z^2)) ↔ B^2 = 4*A*C := by
+  constructor
+  · intro hsep
+    have hrank := kernel_probe_rank_le hsep
+      (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i))
+      (fun i : Fin 4 => polynomialCoefficient (![0, 1, 2, 4] i))
+    rw [quadratic_coefficient_probe] at hrank
+    have hdet : (quadraticMinor A B C).det = 0 := by
+      by_contra h
+      have hfull := Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero h
+      rw [hfull] at hrank
+      norm_num at hrank
+    rw [quadratic_minor_det] at hdet
+    exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hdet).resolve_left (pow_ne_zero 2 hC))
+  · intro hdisc
+    have hA : A = B^2 / (4*C) := by
+      apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (4 : ℂ) ≠ 0) hC)).mpr
+      linear_combination -hdisc
+    have hp : (fun z : ℂ => A + B*z + C*z^2) =
+        fun z => C * Complex.exp (0*z) * (z - (-B/(2*C)))^2 := by
+      ext z
+      simp only [zero_mul, Complex.exp_zero, mul_one]
+      rw [hA]
+      field_simp [hC]
+      <;> ring
+    rw [hp]
+    exact separated_three_exponential_square C 0 (-B/(2*C))
+
+private theorem separated_mul_factors {k : ℕ} {F : ℂ → ℂ → ℂ}
+    (hF : SeparatedLE k F) (a b : ℂ → ℂ)
+    (ha : Differentiable ℂ a) (hb : Differentiable ℂ b) :
+    SeparatedLE k (fun z w => a z * b w * F z w) := by
+  classical
+  obtain ⟨g, h, hg, hh, hsep⟩ := hF
+  refine ⟨fun i z => a z * g i z, fun i w => b w * h i w,
+    fun i => ha.mul (hg i), fun i => hb.mul (hh i), ?_⟩
+  intro z w
+  simp only [hsep, Finset.mul_sum]
+  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
+  intro i _
+  ring
+
+/-- The polynomial part of every nonzero rank-three block is either a
+constant or a quadratic with a double root. All complex coefficients remain
+in scope, including zero linear coefficient and a root at zero. -/
+theorem polynomial_separated_three_profile (p : Polynomial ℂ) (hp : p ≠ 0)
+    (hsep : SeparatedLE 3 (weightedHankel (fun z => p.eval z))) :
+    ∃ c : ℂ, c ≠ 0 ∧
+      ((fun z => p.eval z) = (fun _ => c) ∨
+        ∃ β : ℂ, (fun z => p.eval z) = (fun z => c*(z-β)^2)) := by
+  have hdeg : p.natDegree < 3 := by
+    by_contra h
+    exact polynomial_degree_ge_three_not_separated_three p (Nat.le_of_not_gt h) hsep
+  have hpform (z : ℂ) : p.eval z = p.coeff 0 + p.coeff 1*z + p.coeff 2*z^2 := by
+    rw [Polynomial.eval_eq_sum_range' hdeg z]
+    norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ] <;> ring
+  by_cases hzero : p.natDegree = 0
+  · have h₁ : p.coeff 1 = 0 := Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
+    have h₂ : p.coeff 2 = 0 := Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
+    have hc : p.coeff 0 ≠ 0 := by
+      simpa only [← hzero, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp
+    refine ⟨p.coeff 0, hc, Or.inl ?_⟩
+    funext z
+    simp only [hpform, h₁, h₂, zero_mul, add_zero]
+  by_cases hone : p.natDegree = 1
+  · have h₁ : p.coeff 1 ≠ 0 := by
+      simpa only [← hone, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp
+    have h₂ : p.coeff 2 = 0 := Polynomial.coeff_eq_zero_of_natDegree_lt (by omega)
+    have heq : (fun z => p.eval z) = fun z => p.coeff 0+p.coeff 1*z := by
+      funext z
+      simp only [hpform, h₂, zero_mul, add_zero]
+    rw [heq] at hsep
+    exact (linear_not_separated_three _ _ h₁ hsep).elim
+  have htwo : p.natDegree = 2 := by omega
+  have hC : p.coeff 2 ≠ 0 := by
+    simpa only [← htwo, Polynomial.coeff_natDegree] using Polynomial.leadingCoeff_ne_zero.mpr hp
+  have hdisc : (p.coeff 1)^2 = 4*p.coeff 0*p.coeff 2 := by
+    apply (quadratic_separated_three_iff _ _ _ hC).mp
+    simpa only [← hpform] using hsep
+  have hA : p.coeff 0 = (p.coeff 1)^2 / (4*p.coeff 2) := by
+    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num : (4 : ℂ) ≠ 0) hC)).mpr
+    linear_combination -hdisc
+  refine ⟨p.coeff 2, hC, Or.inr ⟨-p.coeff 1/(2*p.coeff 2), ?_⟩⟩
+  funext z
+  rw [hpform, hA]
+  field_simp [hC]
+  <;> ring
+
+private theorem weighted_exponential_separated_iff (f : ℂ → ℂ) (α : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
+    SeparatedLE k (weightedHankel (fun z => Complex.exp (α*z) * f z)) ↔
+      SeparatedLE k (weightedHankel f) := by
+  have he (β : ℂ) : Differentiable ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (β*z)) :=
+    Complex.differentiable_exp.comp (differentiable_id.const_mul β)
+  constructor
+  · intro h
+    have h' := separated_mul_factors h (fun z => Complex.exp (-α*z))
+      (fun z => Complex.exp (-α*z)) (he (-α)) (he (-α))
+    convert h' using 1
+    funext z w
+    simp only [weightedHankel, mul_add, Complex.exp_add, neg_mul, Complex.exp_neg]
+    field_simp [Complex.exp_ne_zero]
+    <;> ring
+  · intro h
+    have h' := separated_mul_factors h (fun z => Complex.exp (α*z))
+      (fun z => Complex.exp (α*z)) (he α) (he α)
+    convert h' using 1
+    funext z w
+    simp only [weightedHankel, mul_add, Complex.exp_add]
+    ring
+
+/-- Two distinct nonzero exponent blocks already force a four-dimensional
+minor. The projections act on arbitrary entire factors through their
+algebraic extensions, so no polynomial-factor premise is hidden here. -/
+theorem two_exponential_blocks_not_separated_three {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
+    (α : ι → ℂ) (hα : Function.Injective α) (p : ι → Polynomial ℂ)
+    (i j : ι) (hij : i ≠ j) (hi : p i ≠ 0) (hj : p j ≠ 0) :
+    ¬ SeparatedLE 3 (weightedHankel (blockEvaluation α p)) := by
+  classical
+  let f : ι → ℂ → ℂ := fun b z => Complex.exp (α b*z) * (p b).eval z
+  let K : ι → ℂ → ℂ → ℂ := fun b => weightedHankel (f b)
+  have hf (b : ι) : Continuous (f b) :=
+    ((Complex.differentiable_exp.comp (differentiable_id.const_mul (α b))).mul
+      (p b).differentiable).continuous
+  have hf0 (b : ι) (hb : p b ≠ 0) : f b ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    apply exponential_polynomial_block_ne_zero (α b) hb
+    exact Subtype.ext h
+  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := weighted_hankel_three_point_minor (hf i) (hf0 i hi)
+  have hex : ∃ x y : ℂ, K j x y ≠ 0 := by
+    by_contra h
+    push_neg at h
+    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := weighted_hankel_three_point_minor (hf j) (hf0 j hj)
+    have hzero : (Matrix.of (fun a b => K j (v a) (v b))) = 0 := by
+      ext a b
+      exact h _ _
+    apply hv
+    change (Matrix.of (fun a b => K j (v a) (v b))).det = 0
+    rw [hzero, Matrix.det_zero]
+  obtain ⟨x, y, hxy⟩ := hex
+  let F := weightedHankel (blockEvaluation α p)
+  let l : Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1 → (ℂ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
+    Sum.elim (fun a => (LinearMap.proj (u a)).comp (blockProjection α i))
+      (fun _ => (LinearMap.proj x).comp (blockProjection α j))
+  let r : Fin 3 ⊕ Fin 1 → (ℂ → ℂ) →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ :=
+    Sum.elim (fun a => (LinearMap.proj (u a)).comp (blockProjection α i))
+      (fun _ => (LinearMap.proj y).comp (blockProjection α j))
+  let A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ := fun a b => K i (u a) (u b)
+  let D : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℂ := fun _ _ => K j x y
+  have hleft (b : ι) (z w : ℂ) :
+      blockProjection α b (fun t => F t w) z = K b z w :=
+    congrFun (block_projection_weighted_sum α hα p b w) z
+  have hright (b c : ι) (z w : ℂ) :
+      blockProjection α b (fun t => K c z t) w =
+        if b = c then K c z w else 0 := by
+    have h := congrFun (block_projection_weighted_single_right α hα b c (p c) z) w
+    simpa only [K, f, ite_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using h
+  have hmatrix : kernelProbe l r F = Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 D := by
+    ext a b
+    rcases a with a | a <;> rcases b with b | b
+    all_goals
+      simp only [kernelProbe, l, r, Sum.elim_inl, Sum.elim_inr,
+        LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, hleft]
+    · change blockProjection α i (fun t => K i (u a) t) (u b) = K i (u a) (u b)
+      simpa only [if_pos rfl, ite_true] using hright i i (u a) (u b)
+    · change blockProjection α j (fun t => K i (u a) t) y = 0
+      simpa only [if_neg (Ne.symm hij)] using hright j i (u a) y
+    · change blockProjection α i (fun t => K j x t) (u b) = 0
+      simpa only [if_neg hij] using hright i j x (u b)
+    · change blockProjection α j (fun t => K j x t) y = K j x y
+      simpa only [if_pos rfl, ite_true] using hright j j x y
+  have hD : D.det ≠ 0 := by
+    rw [Matrix.det_fin_one D]
+    exact hxy
+  have hdet : (kernelProbe l r F).det ≠ 0 := by
+    rw [hmatrix, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁]
+    exact mul_ne_zero hu hD
+  have hfull : (kernelProbe l r F).rank = 4 := by
+    simpa using Matrix.rank_of_det_ne_zero hdet
+  intro hsep
+  have hrank := kernel_probe_rank_le hsep l r
+  change (kernelProbe l r F).rank ≤ 3 at hrank
+  omega
+
+/-- The exhaustive rank-three classification on the entire complex plane.
+Finite separation first gives a finite exponential-polynomial presentation;
+distinct-block projections and every polynomial degree case then force one

+/-- The entire transform, with the Hilbert-space conjugation convention made explicit. -/

+  inner ℂ (exponentialVector ((starRingEnd ℂ) z)) a

+/-- The factorial-normalized scalar power series of an arbitrary completed vector. -/

+theorem has_sum (a : Fock) (z : ℂ) :
+    HasSum (fun n => a n * z ^ n / (Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ) : ℂ))

+    map_div₀, map_pow, Complex.conj_conj, Complex.conj_ofReal]
+  ring

+    Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖ * (R : ℝ) ^ n / Real.sqrt (n.factorial : ℝ)) := by
+  have h := lp.summable_mul (p := (2 : ℝ≥0∞)) (q := (2 : ℝ≥0∞))

+  convert h using 1

+    abs_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]

+      Real.sqrt ((N.choose i : ℝ)/2^N) /
+        Real.sqrt (2*(N : ℝ)*((N : ℝ)-1)) := by
+    have hden : 0 ≤ 2*(N : ℝ)*((N : ℝ)-1) :=
+      mul_nonneg (by positivity) (by linarith)
+    apply (sq_eq_sq₀ (by dsimp [L]; positivity) (by positivity)).mp
+    have ht : t^2 = (1/2 : ℝ) := Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)
+    calc
+      _ = (m.factorial : ℝ)/(2^N*2*(i.factorial : ℝ)*(j.factorial : ℝ)) := by
+        dsimp only [L]
+        simp only [mul_pow, div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (Nat.cast_nonneg _),
+          Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 2)]
+        rw [pow_right_comm t N 2, ht]
+        simp only [div_pow, one_pow]
+        field_simp [hf]
+        <;> ring
+      _ = (N.choose i : ℝ)/(2^N*(2*(N : ℝ)*((N : ℝ)-1))) := by
+        apply (div_eq_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)).mpr
+        linear_combination -(2^N*2)*hfact
+      _ = _ := by
+        rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), Real.sq_sqrt hden, div_div]
+  have hbin : twoPhotonBinomial m i =
+      (m.factorial : ℝ)*D/((i.factorial : ℝ)*(j.factorial : ℝ)) := by
+    apply (eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero (hf i) (hf j))).mpr
+    simpa only [mul_assoc, D] using two_photon_binomial_factorial m i j hN
+  rw [equal_parameter_fock_coordinate t m 2 i j hN]
+  rw [← hN]
+  norm_num only [Nat.factorial_two, Nat.cast_ofNat]
+  change ((L*twoPhotonBinomial m i : ℝ) : ℂ) = _
+  rw [hbin]
+  apply congrArg Complex.ofReal
+  calc
+    _ = (L*(m.factorial : ℝ)/((i.factorial : ℝ)*(j.factorial : ℝ)))*D := by ring
+    _ = _ := by
+      rw [hscalar]
+      dsimp only [N, D]
+      push_cast
+      ring

+/-- The closed balanced two-photon coefficient for every completed input.
+The difference of occupations is subtraction in Real, including i<j. -/
+theorem balanced_two_photon_occupation_coefficient (a : Fock) (i j : ℕ)
+    (hN : 2 ≤ i+j) (hHalf : (1/2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
+    beamSplitter (1/2) hHalf (tensor a (lp.single 2 2 (1 : ℂ))) j i =
+      a (i+j-2) *
+        ((Real.sqrt (((i+j).choose i : ℝ)/2^(i+j)) *
+          (((i : ℝ)-(j : ℝ))^2-((i : ℝ)+(j : ℝ))) /
+            Real.sqrt (2*((i : ℝ)+(j : ℝ))*((i : ℝ)+(j : ℝ)-1)) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
+  rw [occupation_coefficient_of_total (1/2) hHalf 2 j i hN a,
+    show (1-(1/2) : ℝ) = 1/2 by norm_num,
+    balanced_two_photon_amplitude (i+j-2) i j (by omega)]
+
+#print axioms balanced_two_photon_occupation_coefficient
+

+/-! A dependent-family audit of the completed operator-rank readout. -/
+
+open _root_.D5.S3.ConceptDynamics.InformationEscape.DependentFamily

+open BeamSplitter DisplacementCovariance Attenuator
+
+noncomputable section
+namespace Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.FockAttenuator.RankSeparation
+
+abbrev rankSignature : Signature where
+  Params := Unit
+  State _ := TwoMode
+  Role := Unit
+  finiteRole := inferInstance
+  nonemptyRole := inferInstance
+  Output _ _ := Cardinal
+  Anchor := Empty
+  finiteAnchor := inferInstance
+
+abbrev rankActual : Realization rankSignature :=
+  realize rankSignature (fun _ _ V => rangeRank (purePartialTrace V)) (fun e => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev rankRejected : Realization rankSignature :=
+  realize rankSignature (fun _ _ _ => (1 : Cardinal)) (fun e => nomatch e)
+
+abbrev rankArena : Arena where
+  signature := rankSignature
+  Law R := ∀ (V : TwoMode) (k : ℕ),
+    R.readout () () V ≤ (k : Cardinal) ↔ SeparatedLE k (kernel V)
+
+private theorem rank_zero : rangeRank (purePartialTrace (0 : TwoMode)) = 0 := by
+  have hC : coefficientOperator (0 : TwoMode) = 0 := by
+    symm
+    apply coefficient_operator_unique
+    intro j
+    rfl
+  rw [pure_partial_trace_eq, hC, zero_mul]
+  change Module.rank ℂ (LinearMap.range (0 : Fock →ₗ[ℂ] Fock)) = 0
+  rw [LinearMap.range_zero]
+  exact rank_bot ℂ Fock
+
+private theorem rejected : ¬ rankArena.Law rankRejected := by
+  intro h
+  have hz : SeparatedLE 0 (kernel (0 : TwoMode)) :=
+    (reduced_rank_le_iff_separated 0 0).mp (by rw [rank_zero]; exact le_rfl)
+  have hh := (h 0 0).mpr hz
+  change (1 : Cardinal) ≤ 0 at hh
+  norm_num at hh
+
+private theorem dependence : ObservationalDependence rankSignature rankActual := by
+  intro i
+  have hHalf : (1/2 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by norm_num
+  let a : Fock := lp.single 2 0 (1 : ℂ)
+  have ha : a ≠ 0 := by
+    intro h
+    have hc := congrArg (fun v : Fock => v 0) h
+    simp only [a, lp.single_apply_self, lp.coeFn_zero, Pi.zero_apply] at hc
+    exact one_ne_zero hc
+  let V : TwoMode := beamSplitter (1/2) hHalf (tensor a (lp.single 2 2 (1 : ℂ)))
+  have hpos : (3 : Cardinal) ≤ rangeRank (purePartialTrace V) := by
+    have h := actual_rank_lower_bound a ha hHalf
+    rwa [point_mass_pure_attenuator] at h
+  refine ⟨(), (0 : TwoMode), V, ?_⟩
+  intro h
+  change rangeRank (purePartialTrace (0 : TwoMode)) = rangeRank (purePartialTrace V) at h
+  rw [rank_zero] at h
+  rw [← h] at hpos
+  norm_num at hpos
+
+def rankEvidence : Registration rankArena
+    (∀ (V : TwoMode) (k : ℕ),
+      rangeRank (purePartialTrace V) ≤ (k : Cardinal) ↔ SeparatedLE k (kernel V)) where
+  actual := rankActual
+  bridge := Iff.rfl
+  variation := ⟨reduced_rank_le_iff_separated, rankRejected, rejected⟩
+  sensitivity := by
+    constructor
+    · intro i
+      refine ⟨rankRejected, ?_, ?_, rejected⟩
+      · intro j h
+        exact (h (Subsingleton.elim _ _)).elim
+      · funext e
+        exact nomatch e
+    · intro e
+      exact nomatch e
+  dependence := dependence
+
+noncomputable def rankRegistration :
+    LeanInformationAudit.Contract.Registration.{_,_,_,0,0,0,_,_,_,_,_,0}
+    (@_root_.D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.FockAttenuator.Bargmann.reduced_rank_le_iff_separated)
+    (type_of% (realize rankSignature (fun _ _ V => rangeRank (purePartialTrace V))
+      (fun e => nomatch e))) Type Unit := {
+  unitName := `Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.FockAttenuator.RankSeparation.rankUnit
+  realizationName := `Reg.D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.FockAttenuator.RankSeparation.rankEvidence
+  realizationSource := none
+  generated := false
+  arena := .source ⟨rankArena⟩
+  objectArena := .source ⟨rankArena⟩
+  catalog := Lean.Name.anonymous
+  localNames := false
+  realization := .source rankArena ⟨rankEvidence⟩
+  correspondence := { stage := .evidence, objectStage := .evidence }
+  bundleNonempty := .absent
+  readout := some (realize rankSignature (fun _ _ V => rangeRank (purePartialTrace V))
+    (fun e => nomatch e))
+  variation := .absent
+  sensitivity := .absent
+  partialSensitivity := none
+  escapeFrom := some (↥TwoMode)
+  sourceSelection := some {
+    owner := `D5.S3.Quantum.QuantumChannels.FockAttenuator.RankSeparation
+    definition := none
+    coordinates := #[]
+    readouts := #[{
+      path := #["body", "body", "fn", "arg", "fn", "arg"]
+      stateBinder := 0
+      functionOperand := false
+      stateOperand := some #["arg", "arg"]
+      booleanPredicate := false }] }
+  continuation := .unknown
+  familyRecord := none
+  options := #[] }
+
